galatians.2.p1.b1.text: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem, accompanied by Barnabas. I took Titus along also.

galatians.2.p1.b2.text: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. …

galatians.2.p1.b3.text: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.

galatians.2.p2.b1.text: This issue arose because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses to spy on our freedom in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.

galatians.2.p2.b2.text: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.

galatians.2.p3.b2.text: James, Cephas, and John—those reputed to be pillars—gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship,

galatians.2.p3.b3.text: so that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.

galatians.2.p3.b4.text: They only asked us to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do.

galatians.2.p4.b1.text: When Cephas came to Antioch, however, I opposed him to his face, because he stood to be condemned.

galatians.2.p4.b2.text: But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself, for fear of those in the circumcision group.

galatians.2.p4.b3.text: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.

galatians.2.p5.b1.text: When I saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel,

galatians.2.p5.b2.text: “If you, who are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?”

galatians.2.p6.b1.text: We who are Jews by birth and not Gentile “sinners”

galatians.2.p6.b2.text: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus,

galatians.2.p6.b3.text: does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!

galatians.2.p6.b4.text: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.

galatians.2.p7.b1.text: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.

galatians.2.p7.b2.text: who loved me and gave Himself up for me.

galatians.2.p7.b3.text: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, Christ died for nothing.
